subject.title: fix(cli): bound readInputFiles with size cap in capability-cli

question: Should capability CLI deliberately adopt the new 100 MiB per-file and 500 MiB per-command input contract, and what supported input envelope should users receive?
rationale: The exact limits replace previously unbounded accepted input behavior, while the repository evidence supplied here does not establish that those thresholds match a documented or provider-wide contract.

options.title: Set and document a supported limit
options.body: Approve a supported capability-CLI input envelope, document it, and repair the implementation so the limit is enforced against the opened file contents.

options.title: Preserve larger supported inputs safely
options.body: Replace the hard rejection policy with bounded/streamed handling that preserves the existing supported size range without uncontrolled memory allocation.

options.title: Pause the cap change
options.body: Keep the memory-hardening work unmerged until a capability-owner decision establishes the intended user-facing size behavior.

recommendation.title: Set and document a supported limit
recommendation.body: Approve a supported capability-CLI input envelope, document it, and repair the implementation so the limit is enforced against the opened file contents.
